title: Isolation and partial characterization of cyclic lipopeptide antibiotics produced by Paenibacillus ehimensis B7.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded source recovery reopened primary XML/PDF, duplicate OA packages, figure captions/images, HTML landing-bin supplementary assets, packet database JSONL rows, and merged sequence/experiment/literature outputs. No true Table 3 or structured supplementary table exists in local primary materials for this article; Table 2 was recovered directly from XML/PDF.

semantic_quality_checks.activity_table_repair: Table 2 cation-effect MIC rows recovered from primary XML/PDF; prior activity_table_shape_not_supported issue resolved.
semantic_quality_checks.database_activity_reconciliation: DBAASP PE1/PE2 MIC rows reconciled to Table 1 and Table 2 where target names match; E. coli ATCC 35218 database rows preserved as source_conflict against source ATCC 35318.
semantic_quality_checks.database_sequence_status: APD6 and merged sequence notations preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized/source_conflict when they encode Dab, D-residues, fatty-acyl variants, or collapsed PE1/PE2 identity.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked literature rows are source-verified; DBAASP assay rows are reconciled to Table 1/Table 2/Figure 5 except preserved source conflicts such as the E. coli ATCC 35218 vs 35318 target mismatch. APD6/non-DBAASP sequence notations remain modified/not-normalized or source_conflict where primary source uses nonstandard cyclic lipopeptide chemistry.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repair recovered 16 Table 1 PE1/PE2 MIC rows, 6 Table 2 PE1 divalent-cation MIC rows, and 2 qualitative HEK293T cytotoxicity rows with source locators and units or no-conversion rationale.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to indirect cation-antagonism context and phenotypic bactericidal time-kill evidence; no direct nucleic-acid or direct molecular-target mechanism is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The original ticket is resolved by source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair. The paper is accepted_with_cautions because nonblocking database sequence/target conflicts are preserved explicitly.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary source supports cyclic lipopeptides with Dab residues, D-Phe/D-Val, Ile/Leu ambiguity, lactone linkage, and PE1/PE2 fatty-acyl differences. Database linear sequence notations are retained with modified/not-normalized status rather than promoted as exact unmodified source sequences.
DBAASP rows for E. coli ATCC 35218 conflict with the primary Table 1 target E. coli ATCC 35318; the values are not hidden or normalized and remain source_conflict.

The packet has ten landed supplementary .bin files, but local file inspection shows HTML landing pages and the article metadata reports no true supplement; no additional structured supplementary table was recovered or required for the repaired gate.
Figure 4 and Figure 5 support qualitative time-kill and cytotoxicity conclusions; exact plotted CFU/viability values were not fabricated from figure images.

summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review resolved the prior framework-test failure for the Paenibacillus ehimensis B7 lipopeptide paper by parsing Table 2 into PE1 cation-effect MIC rows, rebuilding PE1/PE2 activity evidence, and reconciling linked database rows without flattening sequence-modification or target-accession conflicts. Final decision is accepted_with_cautions, not clean acceptance.
